description: User-provided manual intensity setpoint versus measured optical power.
notes: Raw ADC counts are inferred as signed setpoint minus signed ADC bias, assuming settled unsaturated integral feedback.
Calibration is restricted to 500 through 9500 counts inclusive at the user request. Higher points are preserved here only.
No dark point was supplied; none was inferred or added. Power values are used as supplied, without an additional background subtraction.
The sensor table uses piecewise-linear interpolation; the helper rejects raw samples outside the calibrated range. Allow headroom for dither and noise at both ends.
Valid for the unchanged detector gain, mixer LO, ADC configuration and optical pickoff used for these measurements.
